item.title: Burmese Cigarettes, Illegal Liquor and Other Contraband Worth ₹55.53 Crore Seized in Assam
item.description: GUWAHATI: Security forces have busted a major smuggling network in Assam, seizing drugs, illegal liquor and other contraband worth ₹55.53 crore in a coordinated operation. The haul included Yaba tablets, heroin, ganja, Burmese cigarettes, illegal liquor, Phensedyl and Eskuf. item.title: India Asks Families of Diplomats in Bangladesh to Return Citing Security Reasons
item.description: GUWAHATI: India has advised the families and dependents of its diplomatic officials posted in Bangladesh to return home as a precautionary security measure amid rising concerns over extremist activity and violence against minorities. The Indian High Commission in Dhaka and all other diplomatic posts, however, remain open and fully operational. item.title: Slow Death of Deepor Beel, and a Community Fighting to Survive
item.description: GUWAHATI: Guwahati’s Deepor Beel, one of Assam’s major wetlands and a notified Ramsar site, is witnessing a steady decline in its biodiversity and fish population. Environmental groups and fishermen say the changes are not sudden but have unfolded over years due to pollution, siltation, and waste dumping in and around the wetland. item.title: Dog-Napping Alert in Dibrugarh: Police Register Case, Arrest Three
item.description: GUWAHATI: Dibrugarh Police have registered a case after several residents reported that pet and street dogs have gone missing from different parts of the city in recent weeks. Locals say the disappearances are unusual and widespread, and suspect the animals are being lifted and trafficked to neighbouring states for meat. item.title: Mayor Without a Mandate: How Mrigen Sarania’s Assembly Ambitions Keep Hitting BJP’s Wall
item.description: GUWAHATI: For nearly a decade, Mrigen Sarania has been one of the most visible faces of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Guwahati. item.description: GUWAHATI: As Assam inches closer to the next Assembly elections, political churn within the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has begun spilling into the open — and nowhere is this churn more visible than in Central Guwahati, one of the five constituencies carved out after the controversial 2023 delimitation exercise. item.title: Three Suspects Detained in Ganeshpara Robbery Case; Police Interrogation Underway
item.description: GUWAHATI: In a significant development in the Ganeshpara robbery case, the Fatasil Ambari police have detained three suspects in connection with the incident that took place earlier this week. The detention was carried out on the night of Wednesday, January 21, and police officials confirmed that interrogation of the suspects is currently underway.
